items.claim: Edits throw on a sequence with a locked part
items.note: This needed a behavior call, which I made and recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: such a sequence takes no edit, its regions are dropped, and `commitSequence` leaves it as it stands, the same rule `redrawSequences` already followed.

items.claim: Dragging or adding a participant breaks box membership (A, plus sweep)
items.note: The sweep found that `addParticipant` had the same flaw as `moveParticipant`, so both now go through `settleBoxMembership`.

items.claim: The Participant click on empty canvas lays out in the default 12px font, not the theme's
The drag preview leaves behind the number digit, the fragment type label and the fragment's own steps
An activation open at a destroy runs past the cross to the diagram's foot
`SEQ_ARROWS` lookups go through the prototype chain, and `setMessageArrow('foo')` throws a TypeError
items.note: This also needed a behavior call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: `insertMessage` and `setMessageArrow` now throw on an unknown arrow name and say which name, and the Message tool's param falls back to a call.

items.claim: `setMessageArrow` reads `both: false` or `async: false` as a change
